fields.summary_ko.0: SanDisk (NASDAQ:SNDK) fell for three consecutive trading days following the leadership change at Nvidia CEO, recording a 7.2% decline to date.
fields.summary_ko.1: Concerns over weak Nvidia demand have raised questions about whether demand for SanDisk's NAND flash memory chips, essential for AI data center deployment alongside Nvidia GPUs, may also decline.
fields.summary_ko.2: Current high uncertainty suggests SanDisk stock faces greater risk of further decline rather than recovery.
